title: OpenShop
tagline: A plugin using REDEEM PROTOCOL that turns Opensea into Shopify.
description: This project modifies the Opensea frontend, interacting with the APIs of REDEEM PROTOCOL. This allows any physically backed NFTs (RNFT, Redeemable NFT) to be traded and then redeemed smoothly and systematically, greatly reduce human effort, immediately turning web3 marketplaces into e-commerce marketplaces.
how_its_made: Our project uses react.js framework. We also leverage existing redeem protocol so the connecting with logistic operation is easily handled. Our extension adds additional codes to the target site interacting with the APIs. We simply put together the 2 things worth combining, though in a non-standard way, but immediately demonstrate the potential of turning existing web3 platforms into web2-ready solutions and solve existing problems
